{"consolidated_memory":"**Data Loss in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt - Five Separate Incidents**

Common pattern across all occasions:
- Component: mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side)
- Problem: Data loss in the offline cache
- Signal: A local row missing after the next launch
- Reproduction: Force stop the app with unsynced edits
- Stack: Kotlin
- Test coverage: mobile/android/OfflineCacheTest.kt

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-03-23]**
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #2013 on branch fix/data-loss-1)
- Result: Memory settled at 330 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

**OCCASION 2: [2026-06-03]**
- Trigger: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: A naive datetime compared against an aware one
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #5260 on branch fix/data-loss-2)
- Result: The nightly rollup matched the source counts for 58 days running

**OCCASION 3: [2026-06-16]**
- Trigger: After the client had already retried once
- Root cause: A listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #6160 on branch fix/data-loss-3)
- Result: The job finished in 71 minutes instead of 7 hours

**OCCASION 4: [2026-08-24]**
- Trigger: Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: An N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #9178 on branch fix/data-loss-5)
- Result: The error rate dropped from 7.8 percent to under 4 per ten thousand

**OCCASION 5: [2026-08-26]**
- Trigger: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: An off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #9249 on branch fix/data-loss-6)
- Result: 45 duplicate rows a day stopped being written"}
